summary: MercadoLibre filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement dated September 9, 2026 for a $1.0 billion public offering of 5.850% Notes due 2036, sold under its existing Form S-3 shelf. BofA, Citi, Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan and Morgan Stanley acted as representatives of the underwriters. The notes are guaranteed by MercadoLibre S.R.L. and Latin American operating subsidiaries. A Rule 134-style pricing press release was furnished under Item 7.01. This is an ordinary investment-grade-style debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing spreads, leverage and any concurrent refinancing of the 3.125% 2031 or 4.900% 2033 notes.
